content.short: Free Sepolia Faucet is an Ethereum Sepolia faucet, implemented as an open-source WebAssembly web app.
content.description: Free Sepolia Faucet dispenses 0.05 Sepolia ETH every 24 hours, with no wallet connection and no need to copy-paste an address. A single click is all you need to claim Sepolia ETH, delivering testnet funds quickly and without hassle. Access is gated by a free 0xNAME, a lightweight identifier that helps deter spam and Sybil abuse while keeping the process simple, reliable, and easy to use for quick Sepolia testing and exploration.
